title: Prologue
description: Nine years earlier in Ludendorff, North Yankton. Michael Townley, Trevor Philips, and Brad Snider rob a Bobcat Security depository. After a heavy firefight with local police and a snowy getaway, their vehicle is hit by a train and Michael fakes his death in a staged ambush arranged with FIB agent Dave Norton.
reward: Unlocks Los Santos and Franklin

title: Franklin and Lamar
description: Franklin Clinton and Lamar Davis work for Simeon Yetarian's dealership repossessing two luxury sports cars (a 9F and a Rapid GT) in Rockford Hills. After a street race through Los Santos traffic and a brief police chase, they deliver the cars to Premium Deluxe Motorsport.
goldRequirements: Use Franklin's special driving ability for at least 7 seconds
Avoid crashes in the movie studio lot

title: Repossession
description: Simeon tasks Franklin and Lamar with recovering a high-end sports bike sold to Esteban Jimenez in Vagos territory at Vespucci Beach. The situation turns into an alley shootout followed by a high-speed motorcycle chase across South Los Santos.
goldRequirements: Shoot the gasoline trail to ignite the bike/car
reward: Experience and reputation with Simeon

title: Complications
description: Franklin sneaks into Michael De Santa's luxury mansion in Rockford Hills to repossess Jimmy's yellow SUV. As Franklin drives away, Michael ambushes him from the back seat at gunpoint and forces him to ram the SUV straight into Simeon's showroom window.
goldRequirements: Take no damage during the fist fight with Simeon
reward: $300 and Michael unlocked as playable character

title: Father/Son
description: Jimmy tries to sell his father's yacht online, but thieves steal it with Jimmy trapped inside along the Pacific Bluffs highway. Michael and Franklin chase the thieves down in Amanda's convertible, with Franklin leaping onto the yacht at full highway speed to save Jimmy.
goldRequirements: Rescue Jimmy within 10 seconds of him hanging from the mast
Deliver Amanda's car to Los Santos Customs with minimal damage
reward: Free vehicle upgrades at Los Santos Customs for Franklin

title: Chop
description: Lamar enlists Franklin to kidnap Ballas gangster 'D' using Lamar's rottweiler Chop. Following a van chase into the railroad yards, Franklin and Chop track down D through freight train carriages.
goldRequirements: Complete with minimal damage to Lamar's van
View the world through Chop's perspective for 10 seconds
Use Franklin's special driving ability for 7 seconds
reward: Chop unlocked as Franklin's companion

title: Marriage Counseling
description: Michael catches Amanda in bed with her tennis coach. Enraged, Michael and Franklin pursue the coach to a cliffside Vinewood mansion and use a pickup truck winch to bring down the stilt deck. The mansion turns out to belong to drug lord Martin Madrazo, who demands $2.5M in compensation.
reward: $2.5M debt with Martin Madrazo

title: Daddy's Little Girl
description: Michael attempts family bonding with Jimmy by renting bicycles along Vespucci Beach. Upon reaching Del Perro Pier, Jimmy reveals that Tracey is partying on a luxury yacht with shady film producers, prompting Michael to execute a high-speed jet ski rescue.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed on the Seashark jet ski
Don't fall off the bicycle during the race
Swim to the yacht in under 1 minute
reward: Stamina boost for Michael

title: Friend Request
description: To repay Madrazo, Michael reunites with heist mastermind Lester Crest. Lester tasks Michael with infiltrating social media giant Lifeinvader disguised as an IT technician to rig an explosive device into Jay Norris's keynote prototype phone.
goldRequirements: Clear all popups in under 32 seconds
reward: Lester agrees to assist in future heists

title: The Long Stretch
description: Franklin, Lamar, and newly released convict Stretch meet Ballas dealers at Rogers Waste recycling plant. The deal turns out to be an ambush. The trio fights room-by-room through the facility, shooting down a police chopper to make their getaway.
reward: Weapons and ammunition scavenged during escape

title: Casing the Jewel Store
description: Michael and Lester scout out the Vangelico jewelry store in Little Portola. Equipping micro-camera eyeglasses, Michael photographs security panels, cameras, air vents, and perimeter layout, choosing between the Loud or Smart approach back at the garment factory.
goldRequirements: Capture all 3 security targets in a single clean photo
reward: Jewel Store Heist planning board

title: The Jewel Store Job
description: The crew executes the Vangelico robbery, clearing the display cases before authorities arrive, and escaping on dirt bikes through subway construction tunnels and the Los Santos River canal with Michael providing truck support.
goldRequirements: Loot the jewelry cases within 50 seconds
Protect Franklin during the river pursuit
reward: Over $1.4M total split between Franklin and Michael

title: Mr. Philips
description: In Sandy Shores, Trevor Philips discovers Michael is still alive after hearing news coverage of the jewelry store heist. Following a violent confrontation with The Lost MC, Trevor wipes out the biker camp in Grapeseed and destroys Ortega's trailer.
reward: Trevor unlocked as playable character

title: Trevor Philips Industries
description: Trevor meets with Mr. Cheng and his translator to negotiate a meth supply deal in Blaine County. When the rival O'Neil brothers attack the liquor store lab, Trevor locks his clients in the freezer and fends off waves of cartel gunmen with shotguns and grenade launchers.
reward: Consolidates meth empire in Sandy Shores

title: Nervous Ron
description: The Lost MC has trashed Trevor's trailer. With Ron providing sniper support from a water tower, Trevor clears McKenzie Airfield, boards a plane packed with weaponry, and executes bombing runs on biker convoys before performing aerial stunt maneuvers.
goldRequirements: Fly under 6 bridges along the flight path
Kill all bikers while riding on the plane wing
reward: McKenzie Airfield hangar unlocked for purchase

title: Crystal Maze
description: Discovering that the Cheng Triad plans to partner with the O'Neil family instead of him, Trevor raids their remote Grapeseed farmhouse, snipes guards, eliminates the brothers, and burns down their underground meth lab with gasoline.
goldRequirements: Complete without being detected prior to entering the farmhouse
Ignite the gasoline trail with a single bullet
reward: Elimination of Blaine County competitors

title: Friends Reunited
description: Trevor heads to Los Santos to confront Michael. Before departing, he plants sticky bombs across The Lost MC trailer camp, destroying it completely before driving to Floyd's apartment in Vespucci Beach.
goldRequirements: 5 headshots with explosives or sniper rifle
Destroy all trailers without alerting reinforcements
Complete with minimal damage to the Bodhi truck
reward: Floyd's Vespucci Beach safehouse unlocked

title: Fame or Shame
description: Trevor bursts into Michael's mansion as Michael is arguing with Jimmy. Learning that Tracey is auditioning for Lazlow's talent show at the Maze Bank Arena, Michael and Trevor team up to confront Lazlow and chase his electric car across the Los Santos River canal in a semi-truck.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed in the Phantom semi-truck
Keep the trailer attached during the entire pursuit
Do not hit pedestrians inside the television studio
reward: Initial truce between Michael and Trevor

title: Three's Company
description: The first mission uniting all three protagonists. The FIB needs Ferdinand Kerimov extracted from the IAA skyscraper. Trevor pilots the Maverick helicopter above the skyline, Michael rappels through the glass windows, and Franklin provides long-range sniper cover from across the street.
reward: Unlocks cooperative FIB field missions

title: By the Book
description: Steve Haines and Dave Norton interrogate Kerimov to pinpoint a suspected Azerbaijani target. While Trevor extracts intel in a warehouse, Michael scans Chumash hills with a high-caliber sniper rifle waiting for target confirmation.
goldRequirements: Do not cause Kerimov's heart to stop during interrogation
Use all 4 torture instruments at least once
Shoot the target on the first shot without guessing
reward: Trevor transports Kerimov safely to the airport

title: Hood Safari
description: Franklin, Trevor, and Lamar travel to Grove Street to purchase cocaine from the Ballas. Trevor notices the brick is mostly drywall plaster, sparking an explosive gun battle in the iconic Grove Street cul-de-sac followed by an escape via Jet Skis through the storm drains.
reward: $0 (deal gone bad)

title: The Merryweather Heist
description: Trevor plans a raid against a high-tech naval weapons project guarded by Merryweather Security. Using a minisub and a Cargobob helicopter, the team recovers a secret subaquatic superweapon, only for Lester to force them to return it to avert federal retaliation.
goldRequirements: Shoot down pursuer choppers without suffering critical damage
reward: Experience (device returned without cash payout)

title: Hotel Assassination
description: The first stock market assassination contract from Lester. Franklin positions himself outside the Von Crastenburg Hotel in Rockford Hills to eliminate Bilkinton Research's CEO using a sniper rifle or sticky bomb before he departs in his security motorcade.
goldRequirements: Kill the target with a sniper rifle
Profit from buying Betta Pharmaceuticals stock beforehand
reward: $9,000 + massive stock market returns

title: Blitz Play
description: A textbook coordinated armored car ambush in Cypress Flats. The trio blocks traffic with a garbage truck, rams the armored car with a tow truck, breaches the rear doors with explosives, and holds off SWAT assault teams before making a getaway in a clean switch car.
goldRequirements: Shoot down the chopper as Trevor
reward: Black-ops funding for the FIB operation

title: I Fought the Law...
description: Billionaire Devin Weston hires the trio to steal two ultra-rare supercars (an Entity XF and a Cheetah) from wealthy street racers. Michael and Trevor disguise themselves as motorcycle highway patrol officers to intercept the racers along the Great Ocean Highway.
goldRequirements: Win the race on the police motorcycle without crashing
reward: Devin Weston unlocked as an employer

title: The Paleto Score
description: Equipped with heavy ballistic juggernaut suits and miniguns, Michael and Trevor storm the Paleto Bay Bank. They blast through the entire police department and military reinforcements, destroying helicopters and fleeing inside a bulldozer driven by Franklin.
goldRequirements: Cause over $1,000,000 in property damage across Paleto Bay
reward: Approx. $450,000 take per protagonist

title: Derailed
description: Trevor jumps a dirt bike onto a moving freight train from an elevated ridge, hijack the locomotive, and causes a massive head-on collision on the Zancudo bridge. Michael arrives in a speedboat to retrieve military shipping containers while holding off Merryweather mercenaries.
goldRequirements: Land on the train carriage on the first bike jump attempt
Reach top speed with the speedboat
reward: Valuable smuggled high-grade contraband

title: The Bureau Raid
description: Infiltrating the FIB skyscraper in Downtown Los Santos to erase Haines's incriminating files. Depending on the approach, the crew enters disguised as firefighters after detonating charges, or parachutes directly onto the roof amidst active building fires.
reward: Erasure of federal records and legal pressure on Michael

title: The Wrap Up
description: Michael meets Dave Norton at the Kortz Center, but the meeting turns into a three-way standoff between rogue FIB squads, IAA agents, and a Merryweather strike force. Michael is trapped in the crossfire until Trevor intervenes with sniper support from the rooftop.
goldRequirements: Shoot down the attack helicopter with a sniper rifle
reward: Survival of Dave Norton and Michael

title: Lamar Down
description: Tanisha warns Franklin that Lamar has been captured by the Ballas at the Paleto Forest sawmill. Franklin enlists Michael and Trevor to launch a coordinated three-pronged assault around the logging facility and extract Lamar alive.
goldRequirements: Rescue Lamar with him losing no more than a third of his health
reward: Unbreakable bond with Lamar

title: Meltdown
description: At the Oriental Theater film premiere of 'Meltdown', Devin Weston informs Michael that hitmen have been sent to his mansion to kill Amanda and Tracey. Michael races across Los Santos in his tuxedo and defends his family in a housewide standoff.
goldRequirements: Reach top speed driving to the mansion
reward: Full reunion of the De Santa family

title: The Big Score
description: The ultimate heist on the Union Depository in Downtown Los Santos to steal $200 million in gold bullion. Either by covert armored car infiltration and traffic light control (Subtle) or tunnel boring machines and heavy-lift helicopters (Obvious).
goldRequirements: Drop gold onto the train with precision
reward: Approx. $28,000,000 take for each of the three protagonists

title: Option A: Something Sensible (Kill Trevor)
description: Steve Haines orders Franklin to eliminate Trevor as an uncontrollable liability. Franklin confronts Trevor at El Burro Heights oil fields. Michael assists by ramming Trevor's truck into a gas tanker before Franklin shoots the gasoline trail.
reward: Heist money split between Franklin and Michael (Trevor lost)

title: Option B: The Time's Come (Kill Michael)
description: Devin Weston orders Franklin to kill Michael for ruining his ventures. Franklin meets Michael at a secluded location. Realizing the betrayal, Michael flees to an industrial ironworks facility, where a catwalk struggle ends in Michael falling to his death.
reward: Heist money split between Franklin and Trevor (Michael lost)

title: Option C: The Third Way (Save Both)
description: The canonical ending. Franklin refuses to turn on his friends and seeks Lester's advice. The trio ambushes the FIB and Merryweather at a foundry, then divide and conquer to wipe out all their enemies: Stretch, Steve Haines, Wei Cheng, and finally kidnap Devin Weston before pushing his car off a Mount Chiliad cliff.
goldRequirements: Kill Cheng with a sticky bomb
Kill Steve Haines with a headshot
reward: $28,000,000 for each protagonist and all three alive and playable
